=== CHARACTER CREATION ===

The year is 1415. King Henry V's banner flies over Southampton as the greatest army England has ever assembled prepares to cross the Channel. You stand among thousands of men-at-arms, the steel of your byrnie cold against your skin, the weight of your poleaxe familiar on your shoulder.

The French think their lands are safe. They believe the Channel will protect them, that their knights are unbeatable, that God favors their cause. They are wrong.

You are not a knight with lands and titles. You are a professional fighting man - a man-at-arms. Your skill with weapons, your strength, your endurance are what keep you alive. Your lord pays you wages, provides food and shelter, and in return, you kill who he tells you to kill.

This campaign will make men rich or send them to their graves. There is no middle ground on French soil.

First, tell me your name:

~ characterName = "unknown"
* [Enter your name] ~ characterName = "William Thatcher"
  {characterName}. A good, solid English name. The kind of name that will be remembered in taverns for years to come.
  -> name_chosen

* [Enter your name] ~ characterName = "John Fletcher"
  {characterName}. Fletcher - from the bow-makers, perhaps? Or perhaps you're the one who'll make French hearts 'fletch' with fear.
  -> name_chosen

* [Enter your name] ~ characterName = "Thomas Blackwood"
  {characterName}. Strong name. The kind that carries weight in a shield wall.
  -> name_chosen

=== name_chosen ===

Your name is {characterName}. Now, how many years have you seen?

* [Young (18-25)] ~ ageRange = "young" ~ endurance = endurance + 1 ~ agility = agility + 1
  You're young enough to believe you're immortal, old enough to know better. Your body recovers quickly, your reflexes are sharp, but the older men look at you with pity - they've seen too many confident lads come home in boxes.
  -> age_chosen

* [Prime (26-35)] ~ ageRange = "prime" ~ strength = strength + 1 ~ wits = wits + 1
  You're in your fighting prime, strong enough to crush skulls, smart enough to know when not to. The scars on your arms tell stories, the gray in your beard speaks of campaigns past. This is your time.
  -> age_chosen

* [Veteran (36-45)] ~ ageRange = "veteran" ~ charisma = charisma + 1 ~ luck = luck + 1
  You've survived when better men fell. Your experience is worth more than youth or strength, your instincts have saved your life more times than you can count. But the wounds ache more now, and recovery takes longer.
  -> age_chosen

=== age_chosen ===

Every man comes from somewhere, {characterName}. Your past shaped you, gave you the skills that keep you breathing. What was your life before this campaign?

* [Rural Peasant] ~ background = "rural_peasant" ~ strength = strength + 2 ~ endurance = endurance + 2 ~ wealth = wealth - 10 ~ wits = wits - 1
  You grew up behind a plow, your hands calloused from labor long before you touched a sword. You know hardship, hunger, and the cruel whims of weather and lords. You're stronger for it, tougher than most, but the world of coin and court is foreign to you.
  -> background_chosen

* [Manor Retainer] ~ background = "manor_retainer" ~ strength = strength + 1 ~ endurance = endurance + 1 ~ wits = wits + 1 ~ wealth = wealth + 5
  You served a minor lord, learning weapons and letters in equal measure. Not quite peasant, not quite gentry, you walk the line between worlds. You understand both the hammer and the quill.
  -> background_chosen

* [Craftsman's Apprentice] ~ background = "craftsman_apprentice" ~ wits = wits + 2 ~ agility = agility + 2 ~ strength = strength - 1 ~ endurance = endurance - 1
  Your master taught you to work with your hands, to measure twice and cut once. Whether smithing, carpentry, or masonry, you learned precision and patience. You're not the strongest, but you're quick-witted and nimble.
  -> background_chosen

* [Squire] ~ background = "squire" ~ charisma = charisma + 2 ~ reputation = reputation + 10 ~ wealth = wealth + 15 ~ luck = luck - 1
  You served a knight, learning the ways of combat and court. You have better equipment than most, understand heraldry and etiquette, but real combat - the messy, brutal reality - is still somewhat new to you.
  -> background_chosen

* [Minor Noble] ~ background = "minor_noble" ~ wealth = wealth + 25 ~ reputation = reputation + 15 ~ strength = strength - 2 ~ endurance = endurance - 2
  You were born with a silver spoon in your mouth, but your family's fortunes have faded. War is your only chance to restore your name and fortune. You have the best gear money can buy, but your soft hands have never known real work.
  -> background_chosen

=== background_chosen ===

Every fighter has something that sets them apart, {characterName}. What is your greatest strength?

* [Brute Strength] ~ strength = strength + 3
  You can crush a skull with your warhammer, split a shield with your axe. In the press of bodies, when shields lock and swords flash, you're the one who pushes through.
  -> strength_chosen

* [Lightning Reflexes] ~ agility = agility + 3
  You move like smoke, strike like lightning. While others are still drawing their weapons, you've already landed your blow. Speed is your shield, quickness your sword.
  -> strength_chosen

* [Iron Will] ~ endurance = endurance + 3
  You can march all day, fight all night, and still be standing when others have fallen. Pain is just a feeling, exhaustion just a state of mind.
  -> strength_chosen

* [Silver Tongue] ~ charisma = charisma + 3
  You can talk your way out of trouble, inspire courage in the cowardly, and make friends faster than most men make enemies. In a world of violence, your words are weapons too.
  -> strength_chosen

* [Sharp Mind] ~ wits = wits + 3
  You see patterns others miss, anticipate traps before they spring, and find solutions when all seems lost. Your mind is sharper than any blade.
  -> strength_chosen

* [Fortune's Favor] ~ luck = luck + 3
  Some men are born lucky, others make their own luck. You seem to be both. Arrows miss you, enemies stumble, opportunities appear when you need them most.
  -> strength_chosen

=== strength_chosen ===

Now for the most important choice, {characterName}. Your lord will determine whether you return with a purse full of silver or a body full of French steel. Each commander offers different opportunities, different dangers.

* [Sir James O'Looney - 'The Reaver'] ~ patronId = "james_olooney" ~ strength = strength + 1 ~ luck = luck + 1 ~ morale = morale - 1
  An Irish knight in English service, brutal and efficient. His men love the plunder he allows, fear the punishments he demands. High risk, high reward. With James, you'll see more fighting, earn more silver, and have a better chance of dying rich.
  -> patron_chosen

* [Lord David Pembroke] ~ patronId = "lord_david" ~ charisma = charisma + 1 ~ morale = morale + 1 ~ reputation = reputation + 5
  A fair commander, respected by his men. He shares plunder reasonably, disciplines justly, and leads from the front. Steady service, reliable rewards. With David, you'll live longer and sleep better.
  -> patron_chosen

* [Duke Caley of Norfolk] ~ patronId = "duke_caley" ~ wealth = wealth + 20 ~ patronFavor = patronFavor - 2 ~ stress = stress + 1
  One of the most powerful lords in England. His men are well-equipped, well-paid, and completely expendable. He cares nothing for individual lives, only for results. Riches are certain, survival is not.
  -> patron_chosen

* [Count Charles d'Evreux - 'The Grim'] ~ patronId = "count_charles" ~ wits = wits + 1 ~ luck = luck + 1 ~ morale = morale - 1
  A Norman lord fighting for England, brilliant but perpetually drunk. His tactical genius is unmatched, his sobriety is nonexistent. Following Charles means following a madman who wins impossible victories.
  -> patron_chosen

* [Ashkhan al-Mamluk] ~ patronId = "ashkhan" ~ endurance = endurance + 1 ~ agility = agility + 1 ~ reputation = reputation - 5
  A Mamluk mercenary commander, professional and deadly. His men are the most disciplined in the army, but the English view them with suspicion. With Ashkhan, you'll learn skills no European can teach, but you'll always be an outsider.
  -> patron_chosen
